Let \(R=r^2\) and \(S=s^2\), so \(1<R<S\). Exactness through degree \(6\) gives
\[
a_1=\frac{RS}{(R-1)(S-1)},\qquad
a_r=\frac{S}{R(R-1)(R-S)},\qquad
a_s=\frac{R}{S(S-1)(S-R)},
\]
and
\[
a_0=-2(a_1+a_r+a_s).
\]

The degree-\(8\) moment yields
\[
T(r,s)=\frac{RS}{20160}.
\]
Since \(a_1>0,\ a_r<0,\ a_s>0,\ a_0<0\),
\[
K(r,s)=4(a_1+a_s).
\]

Minimizing the optimized envelope is therefore equivalent to minimizing
\[
RS(a_1+a_s)^3.
\]
Writing \(S=pR\), \(p>1\), and setting \(x=R\), the stationarity equations reduce, after eliminating \(p\), to
\[
(z+1)^2(z^2-2z-1)(z^2+2z+3)=0,
\qquad z=(p-1)x>0.
\]
Thus
\[
z=1+\sqrt2,
\]
which gives
\[
R_*=2+\sqrt2,\qquad S_*=3+2\sqrt2.
\]
Hence
\[
r_*=\sqrt{2+\sqrt2},\qquad s_*=\sqrt{3+2\sqrt2}=1+\sqrt2.
\]

At this pair,
\[
a_1=1+\frac{\sqrt2}{2},\qquad
a_r=\frac{1-\sqrt2}{2},\qquad
a_s=5-\frac{7\sqrt2}{2},\qquad
a_0=-13+7\sqrt2.
\]
Also,
\[
T_*=\frac{10+7\sqrt2}{20160},\qquad
K_*=12(2-\sqrt2),
\]
and the minimizing mesh width is
\[
h_*=
\left(
\frac{\varepsilon K_*}{3MT_*}
\right)^{1/8}
=
\left(
\frac{80640(17-12\sqrt2)\,\varepsilon}{M}
\right)^{1/8}.
\]

\[
\boxed{(r_*,s_*)=\left(\sqrt{2+\sqrt2},\,1+\sqrt2\right)}
\]
